h:
用户指南

1.该工作流程使用原始的Qwen-Image-Edit2511模型结合多角度LoRA模型生成多角度图像，或者允许手动控制角度以创建不同视角的图像。它可用于故事板创建和 LoRA 素材库开发。

2.通过拨动开关在多角度和单角度控制之间切换——一次只能使用一种功能。

3.提供预先标注的多角度提示供选择。只需复制并粘贴所需的提示即可；粘贴的行数对应于生成的图像数。

4.通过ComfyUI-qwenmultiangle节点可视化单角度控制。下载链接：https://github.com/jtydhr88/ComfyUI-qwenmultiangle

5.在参数选择区调整分辨率设置。

6.包括可选的AIO模型加载器。但测试表明，AIO机型与原2511机型相比，字符一致性较低。它是针对特定用例提供的，其中包含版本 18.1（最有效的版本）而不是最新更新。

7.根据您的具体要求微调其他参数。

8.此工作流程中的角度是通过提示控制的，但仍然受到提示工程的限制。为了精确的角度控制，需要高斯喷射功能。

Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-多角度-LoRA：https://civitai.com/models/2300308/qwen-image-edit-2511-multiple-angles-lora

此工作流程可用于免费在线测试。如果您觉得有用，可以下载到本地使用。

网址：https://www.runninghub.ai/post/2018253621518929922/?inviteCode=rh-v1443

o.en:
User Guide

1.This workflow uses the original Qwen-Image-Edit2511 model combined with the multiple-angles LoRA model to generate multi-angle images, or allows manual angle control for creating images from different perspectives. It can be used for storyboard creation and LoRA material library development.

2.Switch between multi-angle and single-angle control via a toggle—only one function can be used at a time.

3.Pre-annotated multi-angle prompts are provided for selection. Simply copy and paste the required prompts; the number of pasted lines corresponds to the number of images generated.

4.Single-angle control is visualized through the ComfyUI-qwenmultiangle node. Download link:https://github.com/jtydhr88/ComfyUI-qwenmultiangle

5.Adjust resolution settings in the Parameter Selection Area.

6.An optional AIO model loader is included. However, tests show that the AIO model has lower character consistency compared to the original 2511 model. It is provided for specific use cases, with version 18.1 (the most effective one) included instead of the latest updates.

7.Fine-tune other parameters based on your specific requirements.

8.The angles in this workflow are controlled via prompts and are still subject to the limitations of prompt engineering. For precise angle control, the Gaussian splatting feature is required.

Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Multiple-Angles-LoRA：https://civitai.com/models/2300308/qwen-image-edit-2511-multiple-angles-lora

This workflow is available for free online testing. You can download it for local use if you find it useful.
